shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && find .agents -type f && echo ---- && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; cat AGENTS.md | head -100

head -80 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo ---- && rg -n -i "table|grid|pagination" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -40 && echo ---- && ls src && cat src/*.tsx src/*.ts 2>/dev/null | head -150 && cat tsconfig.json index.html vite.config.ts && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | rg '"version"'

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head -50; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head -80; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -60

curl -sSL --max-time 30 -o /tmp/uikit7.txt -w "%{http_code}\n" https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt; wc -c /tmp/uikit7.txt; rg -n -i "table|pagination|withTableSorting|withTableSelection" /tmp/uikit7.txt | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build && ls esm | head -5; find . -path '*Table*' -name '*.d.ts' | head -40; find . -iname '*pagination*.d.ts' | head; grep -rl "withTableSorting\|withTableSelection" --include=*.d.ts . | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Table/Table.d.ts Table/hoc/index.d.ts Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts Table/index.d.ts; echo ----; cat Pagination/Pagination.d.ts; echo ----; cat Table/hoc/withTableSorting/SortIndicator/SortIndicator.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls Table Table/hoc/*
cat Pagination/types.d.ts; echo ----; cat Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js | head -150; echo ----; cat Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js | head -150

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && sed -n 150,200p components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js; echo ----; rg -n "getRowId|getRowDescriptor" components/Table/Table.js | head -20; echo ----; rg -n "Table|Pagination|withTable|Text|Flex|Card|Label|Button" index.d.ts components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo ----; wc -l /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/*.md
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && rg -n "^#|Incorrect|Correct" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -120

sed -n 15,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; sed -n 306,330p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; rg -n "Text.*variant|variant=\"" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/*.md | head -20; rg -n "^export type TextVariant|header-|body-|subheader-|caption-|display-|text-" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/*.d.ts | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && sed -n 1,25p Text/Text.d.ts | grep -v "^\s*\*" ; rg -n "variant" Text/Text.d.ts | head -5; rg -n "view\?:|size\?:" Button/Button.d.ts | head; rg -n "gap|direction|alignItems|justifyContent|spacing" Flex/Flex.d.ts ../components/Flex/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls Flex 2>/dev/null; ls ../components | head -100 | tr '\n' ' '

cat text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls Text; cat Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; rg -n "variant" Text/text/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; cat Button/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls layout; sed -n 1,60p layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules && sed -n 30,50p @gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.js; rg -n "ButtonView =" -A3 @gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/*.d.ts | head -12; rg -n "ButtonSize =" @gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/*.d.ts | head -3; node -e 'console.log("ts", require("typescript/package.json").version)'; ls | rg -i "jsdom|happy-dom|testing-library" ; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && git status --short

rg -n "BUTTON_VIEWS" -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/*.d.ts | head -8; rg -n "export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts | head -3; rg -n "useLayoutContext|Container" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md | head -3; rg -n "ThemeProvider" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -2

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && rg -n "theme\?|size\?|export type LabelTheme|LABEL_THEMES|THEMES" Label/*.d.ts Label/*/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -8; rg -n "color\?:" Text/colorText/*.d.ts | head -3; rg -n "TEXT_COLORS|color" Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -8; rg -n "export type Space" -A2 ../types.d.ts ../*/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -6
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -60; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='src/DataTable.tsx'
s=open(p,encoding='utf8').read()
s=s.replace("""import type { TableColumnConfig, TableSortState } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';""","""import type { TableColumnConfig, TableSortState, WithTableSortingProps } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';""")
s=s.replace("""const SelectableSortableTable = withTableSelection<Order>(withTableSorting<Order>(Table));""","""const SelectableSortableTable = withTableSelection<Order, WithTableSortingProps>(
    withTableSorting<Order>(Table),
);""")
open(p,'w',encoding='utf8').write(s)
EOF
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn"; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn"; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -25; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
